user.title: Connect to MOSS
user.description: Make a token in MOSS (Settings, Modules, Home Assistant, MOSS in Home Assistant) and paste it here.

data_description.url: How Home Assistant reaches MOSS, e.g. https://10.0.0.20 (MOSS shows it in Settings, HTTPS)
data_description.token: Starts with moss_ha_. It acts as the person who made it, and can't approve changes or change settings.

reauth_confirm.title: New MOSS token
reauth_confirm.description: The token was revoked or is no longer valid. Make a new one in MOSS and paste it here.

trust.title: Trust MOSS's certificate?
trust.description:
MOSS at {url} uses its own certificate authority. Check this fingerprint matches the one in MOSS (Settings, HTTPS):

`{fingerprint}`

If it matches, submit: Home Assistant will trust MOSS's certificate from now on. If it doesn't, stop: something else may be answering at that address.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach MOSS at that address.
error.cert_untrusted: MOSS's certificate isn't trusted, and MOSS didn't offer its own. Use MOSS's https address, or untick certificate verification.

abort.already_configured: This MOSS is already set up.

raise_incident.name: Raise incident
raise_incident.description: Raise an incident in MOSS, optionally for an agent to work on.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: The agent to give it to, by name.

ask_agent.name: Ask an agent
ask_agent.description: Ask a MOSS agent a question and get its answer back.

agent.name: Agent
agent.description: The agent's name. Moss by default.

acknowledge_incident.name: Acknowledge incident
acknowledge_incident.description: Note on an incident that you've seen it.

incident_id.name: Incident
incident_id.description: The incident's id (in the Incident event's data).
